summary: The session discusses the current state and future of data governance, emphasizing the need for organizations to adapt their governance frameworks to support AI ambitions. It highlights the importance of integrating technology and collaboration across various governance mechanisms to ensure effective data management. The speaker outlines key drivers for change and actionable steps to future-proof governance practices.

key_points: Many organizations struggle with the effectiveness of their current data governance programs.
Only one-third of surveyed organizations have responsibility for AI-ready data.
The scope of governance is expanding to include unstructured data and AI agents.
Technology is enabling more effective execution of governance policies.
Organizations need to focus on explicit business outcomes rather than just data.
Developing a common language and formalizing stewardship models is essential.

key_takeaways: Data governance must evolve to support AI ambitions and ensure effective management of derived assets.
Organizations should integrate technology into governance practices to enhance efficiency and compliance.
Building a risk register and understanding the language of risk management is crucial for effective governance.
